vulnerabilities.summary: Prototype pollution via a crafted --proto argument allows attacker-controlled properties to be merged onto Object.prototype.
Denial of service via deeply nested query-string parameters causes exponential parsing time.
Server-side request forgery: malformed IP strings are misclassified as public, bypassing private-network checks.
The regular expression used for brace expansion is vulnerable to catastrophic backtracking on crafted input (ReDoS).
ReDoS in the ANSI escape-code matching regex when given a long, crafted input string.
Regular expression denial of service in a formatter used for object inspection under certain locale settings.
ReDoS via a crafted glob pattern during non-glob base path extraction.
Path traversal allows reading files outside the configured static root via crafted percent-encoded sequences.
